prompt: Create a production animation sprite sheet for the camp illustration in the reference mockup. Exactly FOUR equal frames in a 2 by 2 grid, without gutters, borders, labels or ANY TEXT/UI. Each frame is a wide 3:1 panorama, so the full sheet also has a 3:1 aspect ratio (ideally 3072x1024). Extract/recreate ONLY the beautiful painterly chamber scene: four resting adventurers seen from behind around a cozy amber bonfire, ancient stone arches and columns, same reference costumes and positions (human left, dwarf center-left, little hooded halfling center-right, elf with staff right). Keep the composition, camera, background stones and silhouettes identical across all four frames. Do not redraw the HUD, portraits, lettering or controls. Main characters should read mostly as quiet dark silhouettes with warm rim light. The only animated differences are the flame shapes flickering gently, tiny embers and subtle reflected firelight. Four sequential smoothly looping bonfire poses. High detail muted fantasy painting exactly matching the approved image. Fill all four frames edge to edge, no margins. Leave dark quiet stone in upper left for live title overlay. This is an actual game asset, not a new mockup.
layout: 2x2 equal frames, row major; camera/background registration retained; runtime uses fixed base plus fire/light region to avoid generated background drift.
